# Travelomate

## About
Travelomate is a travel intelligence platform for sports leagues and enterprise teams, combining automation with 24/7 human support.

## Thrive - Corporate Self-Booking Tool (SBT)
- **URL**: https://travelomate.co.in/thrive
- **Product Overview**: Thrive by Travelomate is an AI-powered corporate Self-Booking Tool (SBT) and business travel management platform tailored for Indian and global enterprises.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Reduces corporate travel spend by 24% to 30%, slashes booking turnaround to under 45 seconds, maintains 99.8% policy compliance, and ensures 100% GSTR-2B Input Tax Credit (ITC) recovery across all 28 Indian states.
- **Key Features**:
  - 45-second self-booking for domestic & international flights, corporate hotels, and airport cabs.
  - Automated pre-trip policy enforcement with dynamic departmental budget limits.
  - 1-click multi-tier approval workflows delivered via WhatsApp and Email.
  - Direct wholesale NDC airline fares (IndiGo, Air India, Vistara, Akasa Air) and negotiated hotel rates.
  - Consolidated monthly billing with verified state-wise GST e-invoices.
  - 24/7 human emergency travel concierge backing up digital bookings.
  - ERP & HRMS integrations with SAP Concur, Darwinbox, Zoho Books & People, Workday, and Tally Prime.
- **Deployment**: Live across organizations in under 48 hours with zero employee training required.
